lines.beaver: 오랜만이야! 외할머니 생신 잔치에서 소식 많이 들었어.
lines.beaver_en: Long time no see! I heard lots of news at Grandma's birthday party.
lines.beaver_roman: oraenmaniya! oehalmeoni saengsin janchieseo sosik mani deureosseo.
lines.en: Is Grandma doing well? I've been wondering a lot.

lines.beaver: 응, 건강하셔. 외할아버지랑 매일 같이 산책하셔.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, she's healthy. She walks with Grandpa every day.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, geonganghasyeo. oeharabeojirang maeil gachi sanchaekasyeo.
lines.en: Looks like Grandpa is doing well too. That's a relief.

lines.beaver: 그리고 큰 소식! 외숙모가 지난달에 애기를 낳으셨어.
lines.beaver_en: And big news! Our aunt had a baby last month.
lines.beaver_roman: geurigo keun sosik! oesungmoga jinandare aegireul naeusyeosseo.
lines.learner: 외숙모가 애기를 낳으셨구나! 정말 축하할 일이다.
lines.en: Our aunt had a baby! That's really great news.
lines.roman: oesungmoga aegireul naeusyeotguna! jeongmal chukahal irida.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's a boy. Grandma is the happiest of all.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 매일 애기 보러 가셔. 온 가족이 난리야.
lines.beaver_en: Right. She goes to see the baby daily. The whole family is excited.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. maeil aegi boreo gasyeo. on gajogi nalliya.
lines.en: What about Uncle's family? How are they doing these days?

lines.beaver: 작은아버지는 새 일을 시작하셔서 엄청 바쁘셔.
lines.beaver_en: Uncle started a new job, so he's super busy.
lines.beaver_roman: jageunabeojineun sae ireul sijakasyeoseo eomcheong bappeusyeo.
lines.learner: 그래서 요즘 연락을 못 하시는 모양이구나.
lines.en: So that's why he can't keep in touch lately.

lines.beaver_en: Aunt is busy preparing for Sujin's wedding.
lines.learner: 수진이가 곧 시집을 가는 모양이네! 언제야?
lines.en: Looks like Sujin is getting married soon! When is it?
lines.roman: sujiniga got sijibeul ganeun moyangine! eonjeya?

lines.beaver_en: In the fall. Uncle is a little sad about it.
lines.en: He must be sad since she's his only daughter.

lines.beaver: 그런데 너희 부모님은 어떠셔? 다들 궁금해해.
lines.beaver_en: By the way, how are your parents? Everyone's curious.
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde neohui bumonimeun eotteosyeo? dadeul gunggeumhaehae.
lines.en: Dad went to his friend's father's funeral.

lines.beaver: 그렇구나. 다음 달 가족 모임에서 다 같이 보자.
lines.beaver_en: I see. Let's all meet at next month's family gathering.
lines.beaver_roman: geureokuna. daeum dal gajok moimeseo da gachi boja.
lines.en: Looks like everyone's coming. See you then!
